intro: Micronesia has over 600 islands, from high volcanic islands to low atolls.

chapters.title: Four states
text: Yap, Chuuk, Pohnpei and Kosrae are the four states. Chuuk Lagoon is one of the world's best wreck-diving sites. Pohnpei is one of the wettest places on Earth.

chapters.title: Sea
text: Its waters cover an area about the size of the continental US.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Micronesia's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
